about: The shell hanging while the session is locked (docs/adr/0061-crashes-and-resetting-an-application.mdx, decision 6, amended): the person must never be locked out, nor shown what is under the lock. Locked with Ctrl+Super+Q, the shell (its lock screen) stops answering (SIGSTOP). The session ends it after 8 s without an answer and starts it again; meanwhile nothing of Allo is shown, and the new shell shows the lock screen again: the password unlocks, and Allo has the keyboard. Without the watch the lock screen stays dead and the person is locked out. At 1 (1280 × 720).

steps.name: 8 s without an answer: ended and started again; still locked, nothing of Allo shown, the new lock screen up
